shoulder-abduction.name: Shoulder abduction
shoulder-abduction.setup: Stand facing the camera with your arms by your sides.
steps: Raise your arms out to the sides, up to shoulder height
Keep your elbows straight and shoulders relaxed

cues.start: Raise your arms out to the sides
cues.up: Keep going — up to shoulder height
cues.partial: Raise your arms a little higher

shoulder-abduction.tip: Keep your shoulders relaxed and your body straight.

shoulder-flexion.name: Shoulder flexion
shoulder-flexion.setup: Stand side-on to the camera with your arms by your sides.
steps: Raise your arm forward and up, thumb pointing up
Keep your back straight — do not lean back

cues.up: Keep going — reach forward and up
cues.partial: Raise your arm a little higher

shoulder-flexion.tip: Keep your back straight — don't lean back.

mini-squat.name: Mini squat
mini-squat.setup: Stand facing the camera, feet hip-width apart. Hold a chair if needed.
steps: Bend your knees a little, as if starting to sit
Keep your knees over your toes and chest up

cues.partial: Bend your knees a little more

mini-squat.tip: Keep your knees over your toes and your chest up.

seated-knee-extension.name: Seated knee extension
seated-knee-extension.setup: Sit on a chair side-on to the camera, feet on the floor.
steps: Straighten one knee, lifting your foot forward
Hold for a moment with your back against the chair

cues.partial: Straighten your knee a little more

seated-knee-extension.tip: Sit tall with your back against the chair.

rules.shrug: Relax your shoulder, don't lift it
rules.backArch: Don't arch your back — keep it straight
rules.kneesIn: Push your knees outward, over your toes
rules.leanForward: Keep your chest up — don't lean forward
